notes: stripe_price_id values are filled in at setup time from the live Stripe dashboard and mirrored in docs/billing/pricing-config.md. Null means the plan is not purchasable via Stripe Checkout (Free) or not yet configured.
Limits with null mean unlimited within the tier.
The assistant quota is a HARD CAP (no silent overage billing) — the documented model per Phase 4 Part B3.

Workspace (Phase 7): Free gets 1 shortlist and 10 entries per shortlist — a genuine taste of the workflow. Pro/API-Business: unlimited. Exceeding a cap returns an explicit, honest upsell message (403), never a generic error.
Structured search (Phase 8): Free gets 5 saved searches (history + presets unlimited); Pro/API-Business unlimited saved searches. Same upsell style as the workspace caps.

Scouting reports (Phase 9): Pro feature — Free gets 0 report generations per period (honest upsell), Pro 10, API-Business 100. Reports consume a SEPARATE report_quotas allowance, never the chat assistant quota (documented in docs/product/scouting-reports.md).
